title: SIGNAL TOWN: ANONYMOUS TRAFFIC
subtitle: A compact five-stop route that teaches live tracking, yielding, and safe arrival.
briefing: Follow five named stops through a compact town with anonymous moving actors.
ROBOT receives timed measurements, its own tracks, and task intent; actor identity and routes remain in SIM.
Yielding is a valid decision. A physical collision is always a failure even when the route would be shorter.

prediction.question: How should the robot respond when live traffic approaches a planned route?

choices.label: Slow or hold, then continue when the measured envelope is safe
choices.explanation: The local planner and independent Safety gate use current anonymous observations and braking distance.

choices.label: Use the actor's authored route to pass first
choices.explanation: Future scripts and actor identity never cross into ROBOT.

choices.label: Stop forever after the first traffic observation
choices.explanation: A safe hold is temporary evidence gathering; the mission can resume after a validated continuation exists.

running_prompt: Watch anonymous tracks, prediction, validation, and the final safety command at every stop.

lessons: Task places express intent; they do not reveal a truth pose to the robot.
Dynamic prediction is built from measurements and remains subject to the validator and Safety monitor.
SIM independently records contact and physical arrival after ROBOT has made its decisions.
